players.bio: Adrià Giner Pedrosa (Catalan pronunciation: [əðɾiˈa pəˈðɾozə]; born 13 May 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano, on loan from Sevilla.
Alexandre Zurawski (born 1 April 1998), known as Alemão, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.
Álvaro García Rivera (born 27 October 1992) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano as an attacking midfielder.

Andrei Florin Rațiu (Romanian pronunciation: ; born 20 June 1998) is a Romanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano and the Romania national team. Raised in Spain from the age of six, Rațiu progressed through the Villarreal youth academy but did not make his debut for the first team.
Augusto Martín Batalla Barga (born 30 April 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for River Plate. He is a former Argentina U20's international.
Daniel "Dani" Cárdenas Lindez (born 28 March 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.
Diego Méndez Molero (born 29 August 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Rayo Vallecano.

Emilio Audero Mulyadi (born 18 January 1997) is an Indonesian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano, on loan from Serie A club Como. A former Italian youth international, he plays for the Indonesia national team.

Florian Grégoire Claude Lejeune (born 20 May 1991) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano on loan from Segunda División club Deportivo Alavés. He is capable of playing as either a defender or a midfielder, but plays mostly as a centre-back.
Francisco "Fran" Pérez Martínez (born 9 September 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays mainly as a right winger for Rayo Vallecano.

Giorgi Tsitaishvili (born 18 November 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Metz, on loan from Ukrainian Premier League club Dynamo Kyiv, and the Georgia national team.
Gnangoro Bouare Samake (born 13 June 2004) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Rayo Vallecano.
Iñigo Pérez Soto (born 18 January 1988) is a Spanish former professional footballer who played as a central midfielder, currently manager of La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.

Isaac "Isi" Palazón Camacho (born 6 January 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano as a left winger. Club career Palazón was born in Cieza, Murcia, and made his senior debut with CD Cieza at the age of just 15, after spending a short period at Real Madrid's La Fábrica.

Iván Balliu Campeny (born 1 January 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for Rayo Vallecano. After starting out at Barcelona B, he went on to compete professionally in Spain, Portugal and France. Balliu represented his native Spain at youth level before declaring for Albania, for which he qualified via his father.
Jorge de Frutos Sebastián (born 20 February 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.
Jozhua Thomayo Vertrouwd (born 21 August 2004) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a left-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano, on loan from CD Castellón.
Luiz Felipe Ramos Marchi (born 22 March 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano. Born in Brazil, he played for the Italy national team.
Marash Kumbulla is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano, on loan from Serie A club Roma. Born in Italy, he plays for the Albania national team.
Mujaid Sadick Aliu (born 14 March 2000), simply known as Mujaid, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Rayo Vallecano, on loan from Belgian club Genk.
Óscar Guido Trejo (born 26 April 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Spanish club Rayo Vallecano as a forward. Club career Trejo was born in Santiago del Estero.

Óscar Valentín Martín Luengo (born 20 August 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Rayo Vallecano as a central midfielder. Club career Born in Ajofrín, Toledo, Castile-La Mancha, Valentín finished his formation with CF Rayo Majadahonda, and made his senior debut during the 2012–13 campaign, in Tercera División.

Pathé Ismaël Ciss (born 16 March 1994) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Spanish club Rayo Vallecano. Ciss was born in Dakar, and represented GNK Dinamo Zagreb as a youth. He started his career at Diambars FC in his home country, before joining LigaPro side C.F. União on 31 July 2017.
Pedro Díaz Fanjul (born 5 June 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.
Pelayo Fernández Balboa (born 29 April 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Cádiz CF, on loan from Rayo Vallecano.

Randy Nteka (born 6 December 1997) is a professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano. Mainly an attacking midfielder, he can also play as a forward. Born in France, he represents Angola internationally.
Sergio Camello Pérez (born 10 February 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano.
Unai López Cabrera (born 30 October 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Rayo Vallecano as a central midfielder.
